name: compact-keeper
description: Saves each compaction's summary, with the files edited before it, to ~/.claude/handoffs so the context before /compact can be recovered

skipCompactHook.title: Skip the compaction hook
skipCompactHook.description: Stops the "session.compact hook was skipped" notice by not hooking the compaction itself, the step Claude Code's Security default sends past compact-keeper. Each compaction is then saved after it, as it already is where Security default runs first: no token counts, "auto or plugin" for anything but /compact, and an automatic one only at the end of its reply. An automatic compaction in the first reply after a start or resume gets no file, and two in one reply get one file. On other setups, leave it off.
